name: Avatar
description:
A person or account. The image falls back to initials on a deterministic tint drawn from
the palette, so a missing photo still identifies someone at a glance.
signature: ({ name, src, size, presence, decorative, className, ...rest }: AvatarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when a visible name sits beside it.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's (or account's) name: drives the initials, tint and accessible name.

props.name: presence
props.description: The person’s live availability, drawn as a presence indicator.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL; the component uses its fallback when it is absent or fails.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
